messages.subject: Project Quartz - draft report on title
messages.plaintextBody:
Isla, Daniel, Rebecca,

Draft report on title attached. Headlines: title is good and marketable; we recommend proceeding. Three matters for the board's attention - the outstanding Meridian rent review (take conduct post-completion), a £6,800 Carrington service-charge retention, and discharge of the seller's bank charge on completion. SDLT will be £412,000.

Happy to talk it through before the board meeting.

James
